en.headline: August visitor arrivals hit 5.46 million, post-pandemic monthly high
en.dek: The Tourism Board said provisional figures rose 6 per cent year on year, lifting the first-eight-month total to about 36.67 million, up 11 per cent.
body: Hong Kong recorded 5.46 million provisional visitor arrivals in August, a 6 per cent increase from a year earlier and the highest monthly total since the pandemic, the Hong Kong Tourism Board announced on Tuesday.

The board said major international MICE and mega events held during the month, including the 16th Worldwide Chinese Life Insurance Congress and 2026 IDA Annual Conference, the Hong Kong Football Festival 2026 and the TMElive International Music Awards, helped draw visitors from the Chinese Mainland, Singapore, the United Kingdom and other markets.

Mainland visitors accounted for 4.57 million of the August total, up 8 per cent. In the first eight months of 2026, cumulative arrivals reached approximately 36.67 million, an 11 per cent rise on the same period in 2025. Long-haul markets remained stable overall, while short-haul growth continued to face pressure from flight capacity, fuel surcharges and regional competition.

Looking ahead, the Tourism Board said it would intensify promotion of Chinese and Western festivals, including the International Lantern Spectacular and a subsequent Halloween campaign, and expand flagship events such as the Hong Kong Cyclothon, Wine & Dine Festival, WinterFest and New Year Countdown Celebrations.

zh.headline: 8月訪港旅客546萬人次創疫後單月新高
zh.dek: 旅發局公布初步數字按年升6%，首八個月累計約3,667萬人次，按年升11%。
body: 香港旅遊發展局周二公布，8月初步訪港旅客錄得546萬人次，按年上升6%，是疫情後單月新高。
旅發局表示，當月多項國際大型會展及盛事活動，包括第十六屆世界華人保險大會暨2026國際龍獎IDA年會、香港足球盛會2026以及TIMA國際音樂大賞等，吸引不同旅客，帶動中國內地、新加坡及英國等市場訪港人次。
內地旅客達457萬，按年升8%。今年首八個月累計錄得約3,667萬訪港旅客人次，按年增加11%。中國內地及長途市場整體表現保持平穩；短途市場在航空運力、燃油附加費及區內競爭等因素影響下，增長仍面對挑戰。
展望未來數月，旅發局將加強推廣中西節日，包括舉辦國際中秋彩燈匯及緊接的萬聖節推廣活動，並擴大香港單車節、美酒佳肴巡禮、繽紛冬日巡禮及跨年倒數等旗艦盛事的規模。
